RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 45

An all-male panel selecting a male candidate with fewer technical credentials can suggest implicit affinity bias, but director-level appointments often heavily weight political management and stakeholder relations over degrees. 

Do not raise the panel's gender in casual communications or feedback inquiries; making an unsupported allegation will likely prompt defensiveness and harm your professional reputation in the sector. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting your written debrief. 

Panel demographics become relevant only if you pursue a formal municipal appeal or freedom-of-information request. In that context, an all-male panel serves as supporting context if objective scoring records and interview rubrics reveal unexplained discrepancies.
